physical_site_rule.author_site_ID_exact: Original event.locationID (fallback original fieldNumber ONLY if locationID absent in original source). NFKD normalize case, remove whitespace/punctuation, join to source island. No nearest-coordinate or taxon-guided join.
physical_site_rule.source_plot_labels_not_source_taxa: Use author Event habitat alone (not taxon records, elevation, locality); if habitat labels do not match frozen ontology count unclassified and stop rather than recode.
physical_site_rule.source_Event_date_format: YYYY-MM-DD prefix or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD interval, require original calendar year as above; this is confounded with forest habitat and NOT a causal effect.

sampling.source_author_common_method: Only DAY SWEEPING and NIGHT SWEEPING; select same effort within each of 22 original plots. Forest protocol published at 2 day+2 night one-hour samples, dry protocol published at 4 day+4 night one-hour samples.
sampling.source_method_parser: Predefined exact normalized values and phrases 'day sweeping','sweeping day','day sweep','sweep day','DS', and night counterparts 'night sweeping','sweeping night','night sweep','sweep night','NS'. Also parse exact 'D SWEEP'/'N SWEEP'. No generic sweeping without time classification; no daytime inference from original event Date hour.
sampling.selection: For every plot×method sort original source Event coreIDs lexicographically and choose 2. All plot and sample exclusions are response-blind. Source 22 plots×4 Event = 88 distinct original Event IDs SHA256 frozen before original taxon access.
sampling.if_source_methods_unrecognized: Event-only report source samplingProtocol vocabulary counts and STOP; raw species/origin bytes remain unread, do not search favorable method after observing taxa.
sampling.source_capture_duration: Only author Event 'samplingEffort' exactly indicating 1 hour if populated; if duration unparseable or inconsistent in a selected method stop, never invent effort from species records.
sampling.method_and_year_difference: Day/night sweeping shared method opportunity; forest 2016 August vs dry 2017 April is a major remaining season and habitat confound. Equal source effort does not make causal or temporal inference.

next_if_pass: Pre-freeze v1.343 fixed 792 7-of-12 forest panels, add 5 Madeira dry plots vs add 5 remaining forest plots, compare source endemic coverage and introduced negative control with same four original Events/site; one-shot first original 3,281 Occurrence read and seal. Porto Santo dry remains separate supporting context not inter-island dispersal proof.
stop_condition: Wrong 22 physical sites, missing forest/dry habitat, missing source sampling method or 2 per plot, duplicate/invalid site positions or source time -> TERMINAL_NATURAL_HABITAT_COMPLEMENTARITY_DESIGN, original Occurrence 0 read.
